title: 대도시권광역교통위원회 직제 / queue:ADDENDUM:33120:20221227:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 33120, December 27, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measure concerning Personnel Ceiling)
Where, due to the reduction of one position (one Grade 5 position) in the personnel ceiling of the Metropolitan Area Transport Commission upon enforcement of this Decree, there is personnel in excess of the ceiling, a corresponding additional position shall be deemed to exist separately in the Commission until such excess personnel is reduced to match the ceiling under this Decree.
